papers.title: Cutting-edge trends in drought prediction and mitigation using ensemble learning and augmented XAI: a meteorological study
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 machine learning、explainable、shap、artificial intelligence、climate，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Drought affects more than 60% of India's population, reducing agricultural productivity, straining water resources, and threatening socioeconomic stability. This study proposes an interpretable one-month-ahead meteorological drought prediction framework by integrating class-weighted ensemble machine learning with SHAP and LIME explainable artificial intelligence (XAI). Historical meteorological observations (1972–2022) obtained from the Zenodo climate database were analyzed for 49 districts across five drought-prone Indian states (Bihar, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka). After generating lagged meteorological features (t − 1 to t − 6) and addressing severe class imbalance (7.07% drought events), multiple machine learning classifiers were evaluated. The class-weighted XGBoost model (scale_pos_weight ≈ 11.90, without SMOTE) achieved the best overall performance on the independent 2016–2022 test dataset, with an accuracy of 95.7%, macro precision of 84.7%, macro recall of 81.0%, macro F1-score of 82.7%, and a PR-AUC of 0.647 on the highly imbalanced test set (outperforming both unweighted training and SMOTE-based approaches). SHAP and LIME consistently identified lagged Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI), lagged precipitation, vapour pressure, and wet-day frequency as the most influential drivers of drought occurrence. Exploratory temporal analysis further revealed declining wet-day frequency in Karnataka, increasing vapour pressure in Andhra Pradesh, and substantial climatic variability across the study regions. The proposed framework combines accurate drought prediction with transparent model interpretation, providing a practical decision-support tool for district-level drought early warning, water resource management, and climate-resilient agricultural planning in India.

papers.title: Tibetan Plateau uplift increased western North Pacific tropical cyclone frequency
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、high mountain asia、plateau、atmospher、monsoon，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Nearly one-third of global tropical cyclones (TCs) form over the western North Pacific (WNP), with severe hazards impacting Southeast and East Asia. TC genesis over the WNP underwent substantial shifts during the Cenozoic, yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here we show that Tibetan Plateau uplift was crucial in shaping the present-day WNP TC genesis pattern. With the present-day land-sea configuration and sea surface temperature prescribed, Tibetan Plateau uplift from early Eocene to modern elevations accounts for nearly half of the simulated increase in TC frequency between the early Eocene and present day. Mechanistically, Tibetan Plateau uplift generates an eastward-propagating Rossby wave train, enhancing the WNP subtropical high and thereby intensifying the monsoon trough. The amplified moisture supply and reinforced upward motion within the monsoon trough collectively favor TC genesis and intensification. Our findings underscore the pivotal role of High Mountain Asia in the Cenozoic evolution of TC frequency over the WNP. Tropical cyclogenesis over the western North Pacific was largely absent in the Eocene (~55 million years ago) but has increased over time, with Tibetan Plateau uplift acting as a key driver in this evolutionary process via reshaping large-scale atmospheric circulation.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence–Driven Precision Agriculture Systems: Engineering Frameworks for Climate-Resilient Food Production
papers.journal: ABUAD Journal of Engineering Research and Development (AJERD)
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 machine learning、deep learning、artificial intelligence、climate、weather，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Climate change, soil issues, water scarcity, and the increasing need for food worldwide mean we need smart farming systems that can manage resources flexibly. Old farming methods used the same inputs and simple rules for decisions. AI can help us manage resources better by adapting and optimizing them as we deal with complex environmental factors. This paper looks closely at AI-powered precision agriculture systems designed to make food production more resilient to changing weather. The authors reviewed research from 2021 to 2026 in agricultural engineering, computer engineering, and environmental systems. The authors examined how machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, robotics, and IoT sensors are used for predicting crop yields, spotting diseases, improving irrigation, managing nutrients, and automating field tasks. Our analysis shows that hybrid deep learning models (CNN-LSTM) are better than single models for predicting crop yields over space and time. Reinforcement learning algorithms are also better at adjusting irrigation cycles when weather is unpredictable. Using edge computing for system design reduces delays and improves real-time decision-making compared to traditional cloud-based systems. However, there are still big challenges with understanding how AI models work, having enough diverse data, ensuring cybersecurity, setting common standards, and making these systems affordable, especially in developing countries. To tackle these problems, we suggest a framework that combines AI analysis, distributed sensor networks, adaptive controls, and climate risk assessments. The authors provided critical insights into essential research gaps and outline a technological roadmap towards achieving sustainable, resilient and intelligent agricultural systems.

papers.title: Decadal variability of the integrated warm-wet conditions over China and its modulation by the pacific decadal oscillation
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“东亚气候”：标题或摘要命中 east asia、precipitation、climate、atmospher、ocean，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: The integrated warm-wet conditions across China, represented by the Warm-Wet Index (WWI), exhibit pronounced interdecadal variability during 1960–2022. Understanding the large-scale climatic drivers of this variability is essential for elucidating the mechanisms underlying long-term climate changes over China. In this study, Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) was applied to extract the interdecadal component of the WWI and investigate its relationship with the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO). The association between the nationally averaged WWI and the PDO index was examined, together with the corresponding sea surface temperature anomalies and atmospheric circulation patterns, to explore the physical mechanisms linking PDO variability to regional warm-wet conditions. The nationally averaged WWI exhibits a significant correlation with the PDO index, indicating a robust interdecadal association between oceanic variability and regional climate over China. During positive PDO phases, sea surface temperature anomalies in the tropical central-eastern Pacific and the Indian Ocean are associated with an East Asia–Pacific (EAP)-like teleconnection pattern, accompanied by anomalous cyclonic circulation over most of China. This circulation favors enhanced upward motion and moisture convergence over southeastern China, Northeast China, and northern Xinjiang, thereby increasing precipitation and strengthening warm-wet conditions. Conversely, anomalous subsidence prevails over North China and the Tibetan Plateau, suppressing precipitation and weakening the WWI. These contrasting regional responses produce a distinct meridional tripole pattern in the WWI, with enhanced warm-wet conditions in Northeast China, northern Xinjiang, and southeastern coastal regions, and weakened warm-wet conditions over North China and the Tibetan Plateau. Opposite spatial patterns occur during negative PDO phases. The results suggest that the PDO modulates interdecadal warm-wet variability over China primarily through atmospheric circulation changes that influence precipitation. This ocean–atmosphere–land linkage provides further insight into the mechanisms governing long-term climate variability over China and offers a scientific basis for climate risk assessment and adaptation in the context of ongoing global warming.

papers.title: A snow-jet bridging mechanism driving the Afro-Asian summer monsoon precipitation dipole
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、plateau、monsoon、precipitation、drought，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: The Afro-Asian summer monsoon precipitation sustains billions of people across the two continents, and its variability strongly affects water supply, irrigation, and drought-flood risks. While this variability has been linked to air-sea interactions, its connection with land-surface signals remains unclear. Using large-ensemble snow perturbation experiments and information flow causal analysis, we show that reduced Tibetan Plateau snow cover (TPS) contributes to a dipole pattern in Afro-Asian summer monsoon precipitation: positive anomalies over tropical Africa and negative anomalies over South Asia. This relationship is modulated by an accelerated tropical easterly jet (TEJ). Reduced TPS enhances thermal heating, exciting an upper-level anticyclonic anomaly. The easterly flow along its southern flank intensifies the TEJ, enhancing moisture transport toward tropical Africa and reinforcing the low-level anticyclonic anomaly over South Asia, resulting in a dipole precipitation pattern. Since 2006, TPS extent has stayed below 9% (a transition after which the TPS-TEJ coupling substantially weakens), raising uncertainty in future projections of Afro-Asian monsoon under continued warming and TPS loss.

papers.title: Regional moisture conditions and mid- to late-Holocene wildfire variability along the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“东亚气候”：标题或摘要命中 monsoon、precipitation、climate、atmospher、circulation，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Wildfire is a major disturbance in terrestrial ecosystems. Previous studies have shown that since the Last Glacial Maximum, wildfire activity across the East Asian and Indian summer monsoon regions has been closely associated with precipitation variability on suborbital to millennial timescales. However, continuous records of long-term wildfire dynamics and their relationships with regional moisture variability remain scarce in the alpine regions along the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau. In this study, a composite fire activity index (FAI) was constructed by integrating the fluxes of levoglucosan (Lev), mannosan (Man), and galactosan (Gan) measured in a sediment core from Wodi Co, northwestern Yunnan, China. The molecular wildfire record was evaluated together with paleolimnological proxies (Ca/Si, Fe/Mn, Zr/Rb, total organic carbon (TOC) and >64 μm grain-size fraction), TraCE21k-simulated moisture-related climate variables, and records of large-scale atmospheric circulation to reconstruct regional wildfire variability over the past approximately 4.5 kyr. The results indicate that wildfire activity was particularly intense between ∼2.9 and 2.0 kyr BP. During this interval, enhanced lake-water concentration, more oxic sedimentary conditions, and reduced precipitation collectively point to regional drought, while sedimentary organic-carbon accumulation remained relatively low. These findings suggest that wildfire activity was primarily associated with the regional moisture variability in the alpine area of northwestern Yunnan, consistent with paleofire records from southern and southwestern China. From a large-scale circulation perspective, variability in the Indian summer monsoon and ENSO may have jointly influenced the climatic background of wildfire season moisture conditions. Since 2 kyr BP, wildfire activity has generally remained low, broadly consistent with the widespread monsoon reorganization and the shift towards wetter conditions recorded across the Asian monsoon domain. This study provides new sedimentary evidence for understanding long-term linkages between wildfire activity and regional moisture conditions along the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.

papers.title: Neogene birth of the Yangtze River: a synthesis of zircon U-Pb provenance data
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 tibetan plateau、plateau、climate、monsoon，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: The evolution of the Yangtze River is key to deciphering tectonic-climate-geomorphology coupling in East Asia, yet its integration age, whether Eocene, Miocene, or Quaternary, remains hotly contested. To constrain the timing of final Yangtze River integration, this study compiles 11,346 Phanerozoic zircon U-Pb ages from the Yangtze catchment, spanning multiple basins, orogenic belts, and modern river sediments. The results reveal that the diagnostic 45–35 Ma zircon U-Pb age peak from the upper reaches is absent from Paleogene strata in the middle-lower reaches, indicating that detritus from the upper Yangtze River had not yet reached the lower reaches during the Paleogene. However, Neogene strata in the Jianghan (25–18 Ma) and the East China Sea basins (20–10 Ma) show, for the first time, characteristic age peaks at 40–32, 20, and 18–16 Ma, which can be traced back to bedrock sources in the Jinsha and Dadu river catchments. These findings establish that the Yangtze River achieved its final integration during the Early Miocene, refuting Eocene and Quaternary models. Neogene fault reactivation (20–10 Ma) and monsoon intensification along the southeastern Tibetan Plateau generated the topographic relief and hydraulic power that drove river incision and transcontinental sediment routing.

papers.title: Strengthened relationship between August Laptev Sea ice retreat and September precipitation in Central China since 2005
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“青藏高原”：标题或摘要命中 plateau、climate、atmospher、ocean、precipitation，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: Abstract The intensified interannual variability of September rainfall in Central China has led to increasingly frequent and devastating hydrological disasters over the past two decades. This study identifies the accelerated retreat of August Laptev Sea ice since 2005 as a critical, previously unrecognized precursor for September precipitation in Central China. Diagnostics show that post-2005 sea ice retreat and its heightened interannual variance substantially enhance local ice-ocean-atmosphere coupling compared with pre-2005. The resulting surface warming initiates a persistent “warm Siberia–cold North China” thermal dipole, which suppresses the meridional temperature gradient (MTG) over the Mongolian Plateau. This altered thermal gradient modulates transient eddy activity, driving an equatorward shift of the subtropical westerly jet through transient eddy–mean flow interaction, then strengthening the meridional secondary circulation. This configuration facilitates an anomalous anticyclone over the western North Pacific, with anomalous southwesterly flow on its western flank importing moisture across Central China’s southern boundary. Coupled with deep ascending motion, this process drives enhanced September rainfall. These findings underscore the evolving impact of Arctic cryospheric change on mid-latitude climate, providing valuable insights for seasonal forecasting and water resource management.

papers.title: Challenges posed by the digital twin of the ocean to the benefit-sharing mechanism for digital sequence information on marine genetic resources under the BBNJ Agreement and corresponding responses
papers.whyRelevantZh: 归入“AI × 气候”：标题或摘要命中 artificial intelligence、ocean，并通过气候领域与主题关键词双重筛选。
papers.abstractEn: A Digital Twin of the Ocean (DTO), as a cutting-edge product of the interdisciplinary integration of marine science and data science, is transforming the generation and use of digital sequence information on marine genetic resources (DSI on MGRs), thereby posing new challenges to the benefit-sharing mechanism established under the Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Agreement). Drawing on doctrinal legal analysis, this article argues that although the BBNJ Agreement establishes a basic framework for benefit-sharing with respect to digital sequence information (DSI) on marine genetic resources (MGRs), it still contains deficiencies regarding the definition of DSI, the scope of application, and the notification mechanism. Characterized by data hybridity, multi-source integration, data fusion, real-time processing, and artificial intelligence (AI) driven data generation, DTOs further complicate benefit-sharing with respect to DSI under the BBNJ Agreement. Specifically, it is difficult to determine whether particular data or information generated within DTOs constitute DSI on MGRs under the BBNJ Agreement; the data-related rights and interests are increasingly complex; and both the design and implementation of the benefit-sharing mechanism face greater challenges. To address these issues, a progressive approach to defining DSI should be adopted, a hierarchical and classified data management mechanism should be further refined, a tiered periodic fee should be selected as the monetary benefit-sharing modality, and both the Clearing-House Mechanism and the traceability monitoring system should be strengthened, thereby promoting the objective of fair and equitable benefit-sharing under the BBNJ Agreement.
